facts.fact: UNHCR and the Government of Chad established the Iridimi Digital Learning Center, which with Arizona State University offers online training to refugees and host-community youth, with certified office tools and digital literacy training to follow.

The World Bank approved on 2024-09-25 the Chad Digital Transformation Project, which will strengthen the digital skills of the population and train about 40,000 beneficiaries directly, at least 25,000 of them women and girls.
